title: Yeasty, Crisp Tunisian Rice Pastry (Ghriba)
description: A traditional Tunisian dish featuring crispy rice flour pancakes infused with yeast and sesame seeds, perfect for a hangover cure.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine 2 cups of rice flour and 1 teaspoon of yeast.
Gradually add 1 cup of water and mix until a smooth dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes elastic.
Let the dough rest for 1 hour in a warm place.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and brush the tops with olive oil.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and cook the pancakes for 2 minutes on each side.
Repeat the cooking process for each pancake until they are all cooked.
Serve the Ghriba warm, garnished with sesame seeds and anise seeds.
To make the spherification garnish, mix 1 tablespoon of sesame seeds with 1 tablespoon of water to form a paste, then shape the paste into small balls.
Place the spherified sesame seeds on top of the Ghriba before serving.
